name: REGISTRAR SUMP
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO HIM: on the floor before the counter's left end, clear of the ticket spindle (at x 960 his head sat on it in the life proof) and left of the FILING sign and its rope, facing him across the counter (errata 80 C). The queue posts stand on the floor in front of his window, so Thad does not stand in either line; nobody does.
note: REGISTRAR CADWALLADER SUMP, at his window in the partition (doc 04: 'every response is a citation... completely immovable'). Canon gives him no appearance, so he is a plain territorial clerk of the 1850s -- spectacles, white shirt, black sleeve protectors, dark waistcoat (errata 80 B). Drawn first in room-07's composition master beside Thad (style gate step 1), then alone on magenta in five poses (room-07 operation 3), keyed by tools/art/room07-sump.py. BEHIND THE COUNTER, as Winnie is in Room 5: the sheet stops at the ledger's far edge, so `y` is the row under his resting hands, not his feet. Present in every act: the office is his. REDRAWN AT THAD'S PIXEL SIZE (Tyler, 2026-11-02: 'Thad is pixelated, not smooth'; 'Bigger pixels'): the five poses regenerated against a side-by-side of Thad beside him (errata 84 J).
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for Sump.

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest (hands on the ledger) · 1 breath (derived from rest by tools/rig/ambient-breath.py) · 2 writing · 3 stamping, the stamp raised · 4 looking up over his spectacles. Breathing on 0 and 1 at `rate`; every `breakEvery` seconds one break from the pool: he writes, he stamps, he looks up (errata 35 and 77: a deliberate action at least every 30 s). · ACTED ONLY (doc 95, errata 148; cast-unify 72): 5 and 6 the rocker blotter at either end of its rock · 7 Claim One's filing in its glazed frame, held up at the window. Played by their directions, never as breaks.
sprite.redrawn: Errata 111 (Tyler, 2026-11-06): drawn from his crop of the locked cast master (art/staging/cast-master/master-02.png), cast-unify operation 11 (reference/cast-unify-10.txt), snapped to its 4 px grid and cut by tools/art/cast-unify-cut.py --grid 4, registered on the head by tools/art/bust-register.py, head matched to the drawing it replaces. NOTHING ON THE COUNTER IS HIS. Operation 10 drew him with his own ledger and it lay on the room's ('That's a book on a book', Tyler) and slid between poses; the room's counter and everything on it are the plate's, so he is drawn with none of it: cut at the waist where the counter's back edge hides him, forearms forward, hands resting on the open ledger, the plate's own (x 1193-1387, y 430-470), under the counter's back edge at y 437. `y` is the row under his hands; the waist lands on the back edge.
sprite.waistOnNote: The plate row the figure's waist ends on: the ledger's far edge (the plate's own open book, outline row y 427 at x 1290). Whatever lies on the counter in front of the waist is in front of the body, so the body stops at its far edge and only the hands come forward onto it. Tyler, 2026-11-06: 'body is partially on top of the book' -- the waist had been set on the counter's back edge, below the ledger's far edge. Held by tests/counter-surface.test.mjs against the plate.
